_comment: Registry of ALL 67 Florida counties and how each sells tax deeds. Hand-maintained (unlike counties.json, which discovery regenerates). The exporter embeds this in the feed as counties_registry so the app can show every county — including the ones with no online auction. coverage: online = scraped auction platform; in-person = courthouse sale, no online auction (clerk links shown instead). Research evidence: docs/COVERAGE.md.

counties.name: Bradford
counties.sale_info: In person at the Bradford County Courthouse (945 N. Temple Ave, Starke), sales begin 11:00 AM on scheduled dates.

counties.name: Collier
counties.sale_info: In person on scheduled Mondays at 1:00 PM, Collier County Administration Building, 7th floor room 711, Naples.

counties.name: Columbia
counties.sale_info: In person at 11:00 AM, Columbia County Courthouse 3rd floor Courtroom 1, 173 NE Hernando Ave, Lake City.

counties.name: DeSoto
counties.sale_info: In person at the courthouse in Arcadia, sales start 11:00 AM; bidders register by 10:30 AM with a 5% deposit.

counties.name: Dixie
counties.sale_info: In person in the Courthouse Board Room on scheduled Tuesdays at 11:00 AM; register 30 minutes before the sale.

counties.name: Franklin
counties.sale_info: In person, generally the first Monday of the month at 11:00 AM, front hallway of the Main Courthouse facing Hwy 98, 33 Market St, Apalachicola.

counties.name: Gadsden
counties.sale_info: In person on the south side of the courthouse square facing US Hwy 90, Gadsden County Courthouse, Quincy; sales typically begin 11:00 AM.

counties.name: Glades
counties.sale_info: In person at the Glades County Courthouse first-floor lobby, Moore Haven; sales begin 11:00 AM (register in Room 102 by 10:30 AM).

counties.name: Hamilton
counties.sale_info: In person at the courthouse, 207 NE First St, Jasper; the high bidder posts a $200 cash deposit at the time of sale.

counties.name: Hardee
counties.sale_info: In person at the Hardee County Courthouse, Wauchula, conducted by the Clerk.

counties.name: Holmes
counties.sale_info: In person at the courthouse in Bonifay; sales begin 11:00 AM (cash or cashier's check; $200 or 5% deposit).

counties.name: Jefferson
counties.sale_info: In person at the courthouse, 1 Courthouse Circle, Monticello; upcoming sales are listed on the clerk's site and advertised in the Monticello News.

counties.name: Lafayette
counties.sale_info: In person on the north steps of the Lafayette County Courthouse, 120 W Main St, Mayo.

counties.name: Levy
counties.sale_info: In person at the Levy County Government Center BoCC Meeting Room, 310 School St, Bronson; sign in with the Clerk before the sale.

counties.name: Liberty
counties.sale_info: In person at 11:00 AM on the front steps of the Liberty County Courthouse facing Hwy 20, Bristol.

counties.name: Madison
counties.sale_info: In person on the courthouse steps, 125 SW Range Ave, Madison; sale dates set by the Clerk's office.

counties.name: Okaloosa
counties.sale_info: Online via Bid4Assets (bid4assets.com/OkaloosaFLTax) — a separate auction platform; registration and a 5% advance deposit required. Not yet in the live feed.

counties.name: St. Johns
counties.sale_info: In person, generally Wednesdays at 12:00 PM at the Richard O. Watson Judicial Center, 4010 Lewis Speedway, St. Augustine; arrive 15 minutes early to bid.

counties.name: Sumter
counties.sale_info: In person, generally Thursdays at 11:00 AM, Sumter County Courthouse Historic Wing, 3rd floor Courtroom F, 215 E McCollum Ave, Bushnell.

counties.name: Taylor
counties.sale_info: In person at 11:00 AM on the east steps of the Taylor County Courthouse, 108 N Jefferson St, Perry ($50 bid increments, $200 cash deposit).

counties.name: Union
counties.sale_info: In person in the lobby of the Union County Courthouse, 55 W Main St, Lake Butler, starting 11:00 AM.

counties.name: Wakulla
counties.sale_info: In person, generally Wednesdays at 10:00 AM in the main first-floor lobby outside Official Records Room 121, Wakulla County Courthouse, Crawfordville.
